blocks.text: Today, GRAMMY®-nominated, Diamond-certified superstar Teddy Swims announces his highly anticipated second album, UGLY, out January 22 on Warner Records. Swims wrote UGLY over the last 15 months since his son was born and it serves as an outlet for self reflection and growth as both a man and father. Pre-order HERE. Setting the stage for what’s ahead, Swims releases his new single, “Perfect Man,” a soul-baring anthem about the impossible standards we set for ourselves and learning to find strength in our imperfections.
